vertices.label: process
vertices.name: Debug and Fix Tailwind CSS & shadcn/ui Integration
vertices.summary: A multi-step debugging process to resolve styling and build issues after integrating shadcn/ui with a Next.js project. The root cause was a version conflict with Tailwind CSS v4 and a series of configuration mismatches.

vertices.label: task
vertices.name: Observe UI Styling Failure
vertices.details: Initial observation that shadcn/ui component styles were not being applied.

vertices.label: task
vertices.name: Analyze package.json
vertices.details: Discovered usage of unstable Tailwind CSS v4 and the deprecated, conflicting '@tailwindcss/postcss' package.

vertices.label: task
vertices.name: Downgrade Tailwind CSS and Remove Conflict
vertices.details: Removed '@tailwindcss/postcss' and downgraded 'tailwindcss' to v3.4.1 for stability.

vertices.label: task
vertices.name: Correct postcss.config.mjs
vertices.details: Updated postcss.config.mjs syntax from CommonJS ('module.exports') to ES Modules ('export default') to fix a build error, ensuring it was compatible with the .mjs extension and Tailwind CSS v3.

vertices.label: task
vertices.name: Update tailwind.config.ts
vertices.details: Extended the theme in tailwind.config.ts to map CSS variables from globals.css (e.g., --border) to Tailwind classes (e.g., border-border), fixing the 'class does not exist' build error.

vertices.label: task
vertices.name: Verify UI and Build
vertices.details: Confirmed that the build process completed successfully and all UI components rendered with the correct styles.
